name: evolving-claude-md
description: Turn CLAUDE.md into a living Decisions & Learnings log that stays bounded: a format contract enforced at write time by a PreToolUse lint, four downward pressures (strike-through, merge, graduation, quarterly archive), staleness detection against the tree, and a tree-grounded coverage check for the essentials a file can pass every size threshold and still be missing.
